name: ALMIRALL S.A.  EO -,12
summary: Almirall S.A. is a global pharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing innovative medicines in dermatology and other specialty areas. The company's product portfolio includes prescription drugs and medical devices for the treatment of skin diseases, and is headquartered in Barcelona, Spain. Almirall is committed to providing innovative solutions to improve the health and well-being of patients.
